skill.name: Gaara of the Sand
skill.desc: Gaara has <font color="#4dc831">Super Armor</font>. After Gaara executes <font color="#4dc831">Wind Style - Sandstorm</font>, additionally executes <font color="#4dc831">Wind Style - Sand Surfing</font>. Whenever Gaara causes a <font color="#4dc831">Critical Hit</font>, he also causes <font color="#4dc831">Level 2 - Blindness</font>.

skill.name: Wind Style - Sandstorm
skill.desc: At the beginning of every round, causes unavoidable small damage and <font color="#4dc831">Discouragement</font> to up to 4 units in the opponent's lineup in front.

skill.name: Summer Spirit - Raging Sand
skill.desc: While Gaara is alive, whenever non-<font color="#4dc831">Swimsuit</font> or <font color="#4dc831">Summer</font> units in any field suffer the first damage in a round, reduces that unit's Standard Attack damage by 50% and healings received by 40%, lasts until the end of the round.

skill.name: Hot Summer - Extreme Sand Surfing
skill.desc: Causes damage to up to 7 units in the opponent's field, causes <font color="#4dc831">Knockdown</font> to the selected unit. If the selected unit is suffering from <font color="#4dc831">Suppress Super Armor</font>, this skill has extra <font color="#4dc831">Critical Rate</font> and Gaara receives <font color="#4dc831">Level 2 Super Armor</font> until the end of the round.
